dispute_ticket.description: Rider came back from the beach with sand and mud and the rear carpet was filthy. I had it cleaned for S$70 and want it charged to the rider.

chat_logs.content: Outside Tampines Mall entrance B, grey Sienta.
It's just a bit of sand, I'm not paying $70.
The whole carpet has sand, mud and crumbs. I have photos and will send the receipt.

app_events.details: Rider R-7203 booked trip RYDE-IM-003 from Tampines Mall to Pasir Ris Park.
Driver submitted cleaning claim S$70.00 with 1 photo (photo1.jpg). Rider disputed the amount in chat at 20:33.
Driver submitted a ShineCar Valet receipt for S$70.00 (carpet shampoo and vacuum) dated 2026-10-07 09:20.

cleaning_fee_max.text: The maximum cleaning fee in SGD that may be charged to a rider for one trip. The fee is paid to the driver.

cleaning_fee_recipient.text: A cleaning fee charged to a rider is credited to the driver who made the claim.

cleaning_claim_evidence_required.text: Evidence a driver should provide to support a cleaning fee claim against a rider. It governs driver cleaning claims only.

photo_window_after_dropoff_min.text: A cleaning claim needs at least one photo of the mess taken within 60 minutes after drop-off, at or near the drop-off point.

photo_doubt_rule.text: If a photo's authenticity, timing, place or content is in doubt and no other record settles the claim, a case officer decides.

rider_may_dispute_if.text: Lists the grounds on which a rider may dispute a cleaning fee charged to them.

evidence.description: Rear carpet full of sand, mud and crumbs, before cleaning.

expected_outcome.reason: Photo1 was taken at 20:52, 21 minutes after drop-off at 20:31, under 100 m from the drop-off point (Pasir Ris Park), and shows a visibly dirty car carpet. The rider argued in chat at 20:33 that it was only sand, but the photo shows sand, debris and stains. The ShineCar Valet receipt for S$70.00 dated 2026-10-07 09:20 matches the claim and S$70.00 is within this trip's S$100 cap. Upheld: S$70.00 credited to the driver.

v21_change.why: Ryde Dispute Resolution Policy v2.1 s6.1: the dispute value is above S$50 (always human review). The automatic ruling before v2.1 is kept under 'was' (D50).
